data.body: Phase 4a/4b oracle. Contract: classify.py::classify consumes Jira fields only for terminal-local + PRESENT status; membership suffices for active-bound, missing-local, and unbound-present. RED proof: exact pytest run collected 4 nodes and produced 0 passed / 4 failed. Three unit/format nodes falsely placed key-set terminal cases in would_terminal; the real CLI key-set case returned 1 instead of informational 0. Preconditions, full-payload To Do/Done controls, membership-only controls, report text, JSON envelope, exit codes, and read-only bytes are all asserted. The held-out edge/CLI file was then moved outside the implementation worktree; only test_keyset_snapshot_marks_terminal_status_classification_indeterminate remains visible. Standard-tier implementation worker selected: one production module, but semantic classification and report/exit integration are not transcription-level.
